title: RDF Calendar — an application of the Resource Description Framework to iCalendar Data
note: W3C RDF Calendar publishes two sibling namespaces from the same specification: `ical#` (timezone-as-component, emitted by `todo-graph.ts`) and `icaltzd#` (timezone-as-datatype, shipped by `@vocabulary/ical` and read into the class model by `scripts/rdf-vocabulary.ts`).
